        directory = os.open(STATE, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
        try:
            client.connect(f'/proc/self/fd/{directory}/control.sock')
        finally:
            os.close(directory)
